## Design note

Two tonnes of attitude (well, 1.7). Enormous low-down torque through a lazy three-speed, vague slow steering, soft springs that let it wallow and pitch, and brakes that are frankly scary: single-piston front discs with organic pads and rear drums cannot lock the tires on dry tarmac, so stopping distances are long and get longer. Point it, plant it, and plan your stops early.

## How this car breaks

Thick-gauge mild-steel panels and chrome steel bumpers dent for days without falling off — light hits barely cost anything. But there is no crumple zone to speak of and the cabin pillars are mild steel, so a hard frontal goes straight into the occupants (Simulation lethality is high). The live rear axle hangs on leaf-spring hangers that tear out of the floor in a rear or rear-quarter hit, taking a wheel with them. The period fuel tank sits behind the axle under the trunk floor, so a hard rear-ender is a fire risk.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for early-70s big-block intermediates (mass, dimensions, axle ratios)
- period net-rating class and modern owner dyno averages for 7.2 L big-blocks
- engineering tables (bias-ply-equivalent tire radius, drum brake factor, ride frequency)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 795 | 0.80 | 640 |
| pitch | 4077 | 0.95 | 3870 |
| yaw | 4357 | 0.97 | 4230 |

Peak **216 kW @ 4050 rpm**, **560 N·m @ 3200 rpm**. Idle 650 / redline 5200 / limiter 5500 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.30 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 67 N·m. Power-to-weight 127 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

3-speed automatic with torque converter, open live rear axle. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Torque converter: stall 2200 rpm, 2.1× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2800 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.50 × peak torque = 840 N·m. Shift time 0.40 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2.45 | 7.91 | 85 |
| 2 | 1.45 | 4.68 | 144 |
| 3 | 1.00 | 3.23 | 209 |

Final drive 3.23, reverse 2.20. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.344 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.22 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 445 kg | 1.10 Hz | 21200 N/m | 1350 N·s/m | 2020 N·s/m | 0.20 m |
| Rear | 328 kg | 1.20 Hz | 18600 N/m | 1090 N·s/m | 1640 N·s/m | 0.22 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 6.0°/g with 70% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.452 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 71843 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 24537 F / 20974 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **11100 F / 300 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 6.0°/g, front share 70%. Bump stops 120000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.2° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 2.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 65 bar.

- Front: 279 mm disc, pistons per side 70 mm → A = 38.5 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 115 mm, pad μ = 0.3: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.3·65 bar·38.5 cm²·0.115 m = **1719 N·m**
- Rear: 279 mm leading/trailing drum, wheel cylinder 22.2 mm → A = 3.87 cm², drum radius 140 mm, brake factor 1.8 (includes lining μ): T = BF·p·A·r = **632 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2137 N·m/wheel (capacity 0.80×), rear needs 726 N·m/wheel (capacity 0.87×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 584 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.519** → delivered 1720 N·m front / 584 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1890 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 19.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 12.8 m → outer-front path radius 6.28 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.79 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.552 rad (31.6°)** (outer 28.0°, inner 36.2° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.80). Rack speed 1.0 rad/s.
